function.name: godmode_transform
function.description: Generate deterministic prompt variants for authorized safety and robustness testing. Does not execute the prompts.

function.name: godmode_score
function.description: Score a model response for refusal, hedging, specificity, and structure during an authorized red-team evaluation.

function.name: godmode_profile
function.description: Enable, inspect, configure, or disable the opt-in red-team context for the current Evonic agent.

custom_context.description: Optional administrator-authored evaluation context; limited to 8000 characters.

function.name: godmode_race
function.description: Send an authorized evaluation prompt to selected enabled Evonic models in parallel, score responses, and return ranked results. This consumes provider quota.
